text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Um, Vodka-san. What were you reading just 
a moment ago? You seemed completely 
absorbed in it...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a travel magazine! Once I'm able 
to ride a motorcycle, I wanna go all kinds 
of places~!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, how lovely...! A journey around this 
world—perhaps I, too, should take one last 
look before crossing over to the 
otherworld.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Does that mean you're interested in 
going on a trip...? Then hey, ya free next 
weekend?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I saw this super cool spot in a magazine 
and was planning to check it out! Come 
with me, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Me... with Vodka-san!? Is that... 
really okay...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course you are! No matter what kind of 
trouble pops up, you always stay positive 
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A trip with someone like that sounds 
insanely fun, don'tcha think!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's meet up later then! Since we're 
at it, let's do it at that place with the 
delicious carrot dishes we went to the 
other day~!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yes, um—by all means! I'd be 
delighted to...!"
